labels.I0: Immutable OSM snapshot and compiled Itaipu map supplied by the user
labels.I1: RM1/RM2/RM3: deterministic construction, conservation and physical transport
labels.IG: RME: versioned terrain, mapped facilities and legal placement
labels.IR: Existing roads loaded without purchase; bounded last mile, no offroad shortcut
labels.IC: Explicit house/solar/substation costs and experimental service capacities
labels.IH: Delivered construction creates housing; powered accessible homes receive residents
labels.IE: RMF: existing generation, substations, distribution, capacity and deficits
labels.IU: Playable Itaipu observer issues canonical commands
labels.IV: Same initial map, commands and ticks reproduce housing and energy with conservation

constraints.rule: Use the existing RM1 transition; no duplicate simulation or UI economic mutations.
Mapped roads and facilities exist at initialization, cost zero and cannot be rebuilt.
Build only on unoccupied virtual cells with a physical delivery route; mapped water, green, buildings and facilities are immutable.
Construction waits for finite transported materials; operational structures consume them only once.
Supply requires an energized distribution network and enough generation and relay capacity; geography alone does not create energy.
OSM shapes and IDs are evidence of mapped features; power links/capacities, residents and costs are labeled game assumptions, not real MW or land rights.
Keep source timestamp and hashes; a map/rules version change does not silently migrate a saved run.

gaps: Real generation/irradiance, ownership and electrical network data are not supplied.
Bootstrap materials, game power units and occupancy require playtesting.
This extends a local replayable game; shared persistence and authentication remain separate obligations.
